component.name: App Entries
component.summary: Hide, show and edit app launcher entries

description.p: A GTK 4 app with a Material 3 Expressive style for choosing which installed applications appear in your app launcher. It uses standard freedesktop.org desktop-entry overrides in your own folder, so it never changes system files itself; uninstalling a package runs your package manager in your own terminal.

ul.li: Every installed app in one searchable list, including Flatpak, Snap and AppImage apps, with hidden ones kept apart
Hide or show apps with one click, or several at once, with Undo
A page for each app: how it looks in your launcher, its settings and everything you can do with it
Edit any app's entry, and find leftover files, missing programs and duplicates
Add AppImages, app folders, Windows programs and other downloads, with their name and icon filled in
Make launchers for programs, scripts and commands (in one terminal or several), and web apps that open a site in its own window
Styled icons from thousands of symbols or your own SVGs
Turn login programs on and off
Choose which app opens links, folders and each kind of file, or each file type one app opens
Edited apps that are uninstalled are hidden from menus, with the edits kept for a reinstall
Uninstall Flatpak, Snap, AppImage, Steam and package-manager apps, showing what else uses them first
Shortcuts to helper apps like Flatseal, Gear Lever and ProtonUp-Qt
A history of every change, each with Undo
Export your changes to another computer, and update from GitHub with one button
